body:
Phase 1 of ECOWAR-MAPEDIT-NORTH: wrote ECOWAR/docs/ARENA_API.md documenting the real, existing PARENA mod-hook ABI (trigger-only vs real-decision-logic tiers, generate-commit-wire build process, full current mod inventory including the confirmed card_effect gap). Then exercised it live: founder real-time ask (Bacon+Puck intangibility -> movement speed) implemented as a real PARENA mod (redgarden/bacon_puck_intangible_speed_mod.prn) wired into both REDGARDEN and ECOWAR's own arena_game.c. Verified: all 4 build/test scripts in both repos exit clean, CI green on both (REDGARDEN run 33127235329, ECOWAR run 33127239849, after also fixing a missed hardcoded mod list in each repo's own ci.yml Windows cross-compile step). ECOWAR commits 52dc22f/b44e72b/766beff, REDGARDEN commits 37a5396/9755bf9, PARENA commit 96f1b83.

⚓ ☃
title: Phase 1 (Arena API v0) + Bacon+Puck intangibility speed boost
